tests.procedure: Weighing bottle previously dried at 105 C, cooled in desiccator (W0). Weigh accurately 1.000 g (W1 = empty bottle + material). Dry in calibrated oven at 105 C for 2 h; cool in desiccator; weigh (W2). Repeat until constant weight. % LOD = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.reference: USP Loss on Drying <731>; In-house specification NMT 5.0% of its weight

tests.procedure: Aseptic technique under validated LAF. Weigh about 10 g in a sterile container, dissolve in Soybean Casein Digest broth (SCDB) to 100 mL homogeneous suspension with continuous mixing (use within 1 h). Pipette 1 mL into each of 4 sterile petri dishes; to the first 2 add 15 to 20 mL SCDA, to the other 2 add SDA (melted, cooled, held at about 45 C). Tilt/rotate to mix, solidify at room temperature, invert; incubate SCDA plates 48-72 h at 30-35 C for TAMC. Count colonies; CFU/g = (plate1 + plate2)/2 x DF, DF = 10; if none recovered report 'less than DF CFU per gram' (e.g. less than 10). Limit NMT 10^3 CFU/g.
tests.source: Soya Isoflavone Extract 10-12%__Soya Isoflavone Extract -SM - Micro.txt:34

tests.procedure: Same preparation as TAMC (same suspension, 1 mL into each of 2 plates with Sabouraud Dextrose Agar, 15-20 mL, melted and held at about 45 C); incubate SDA plates 5-7 days at 20-25 C; count colonies; CFU/g = (plate1 + plate2)/2 x DF, DF = 10. Limit NMT 10^2 CFU/g.
tests.source: Soya Isoflavone Extract 10-12%__Soya Isoflavone Extract -SM - Micro.txt:34

tests.procedure: Incubate the prepared SCDB (10 g in 100 mL) at 30-35 C for 24-48 h. Transfer 1 mL to 10 mL MacConkey Broth (MBP), incubate 42-44 C for 24-48 h. Subculture both incubated media on MacConkey Agar (MAR), incubate 30-35 C for 18-24 h. Brick-red colonies (possibly with precipitated bile zone) = possible E. coli; confirm: Gram stain (gram-negative short rods); EMB agar 30-35 C 24-48 h (dark-centred colonies with or without metallic sheen); TBX agar 42-44 C 18-72 h (blue or green colonies without medium colour change); identification system, report present if probability > 70%. Limit: absent in 10 g.

details.selectiveBroth: MacConkey Broth 10 mL, 1 mL transfer, 42-44 C, 24-48 h
confirmatory: EMB agar 30-35 C 24-48 h: dark centered colonies +/- metallic sheen
TBX agar 42-44 C 18-72 h: blue or green colonies, no medium colour change
details.reference: USP 2024 <2022>; spec per USP 2024 <2023>; USP 2024 Powdered Soy Isoflavones Extract Monograph

tests.source: Soya Isoflavone Extract 10-12%__Soya Isoflavone Extract -SM - Micro.txt:35

tests.procedure: Transfer 1 mL of the SCDB incubated 18-24 h to 10 mL Rappaport Vassiliadis Salmonella broth (RVS), incubate 30-35 C 18-24 h. Subculture both incubated broths on XLD, BGA or HEA, incubate 30-35 C 24-48 h. Suspect colonies: red with or without black centres on XLD; small transparent colourless or opaque pink/white (often pink-red zone) on BGA; blue-green with or without black centres on HEA. Confirm: Gram stain (gram-negative short rods); TSI slant/butt (alkaline red slant and acid yellow butt, with or without H2S blackening), 30-35 C 24-48 h; identification system, present if probability > 70%. Limit: absent in 10 g.

details.enrichment: RVS 10 mL, 1 mL transfer from SCDB incubated 18-24 h, 30-35 C 18-24 h
confirmatory: TSI agar 30-35 C 24-48 h: alkaline slant (red), acidic butt (yellow), +/- H2S
details.reference: USP 2024 <2022>; spec per USP 2024 <2023>; USP 2024 Powdered Soy Isoflavones Extract Monograph
